summary.description: The plan in markdown, at most 300 words: its shape, which goals each milestone serves, Open (gaps or contradictions in the brief and the default you used), and what you left out (procedure plan-project.md).

milestones.description: Proposed milestones in completion order, first to finish first. Each becomes an epic ticket only after Andy approves.

title.description: A short name without the milestone number; the order gives the number.

goal.description: One sentence: who can do what when it is done.

doneWhen.description: Checks Andy can verify in minutes by looking: a URL, a command, a flow, a number.

slices.description: Rough slices, one line each, for orientation; refinement cuts the real tickets later.
